description: Local fake gateway/config fixture for the T24 demo. The gateway block and tenant records mirror the tenant target contract of server/core/multi-tenant-gateway.js (getHttpTargetForCurrentRequest / getHttpTargetForTenantId build baseUrl from tenant.host:tenant.port and send Authorization: Bearer <tenant.token>). 'port: null' is a placeholder the demo runner replaces with the ephemeral port the fake backend actually binds.
